name: Austin Nature & Science Center
hours_summary: Mon–Sat · 9 AM – 5 PM · Sun noon – 5 PM
tagline: A free, hands-on nature museum in Zilker Park with live wildlife and a dinosaur dig.
description: A City of Austin nature center at the west edge of Zilker Park. Live non-releasable Texas wildlife (owls, hawks, bobcats, snakes) share the site with a kids' dinosaur-fossil dig pit and a trail system that connects to Barton Creek — all free.

tips.text: Always free — a suggested donation is appreciated.
Combine with the UMLAUF and Zilker Botanical Garden — all three are within a 10-minute walk.

highlights.item: Non-releasable Central Texas raptors and mammals
Reconstructed fossil dig site for kids

distance_landmark: In Zilker Park, 2.5 mi west of downtown
